  html:

---

Sample characteristics, CP and CD descriptives and outlier detection in the adult cohort (BLS), and the intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) control analysis.

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized.csv`
- Outputs:
  - `outputs/tables/Table1A_cont_normal_<date>.csv`, `Table1B_cont_skew_<date>.csv`, `Table1C_categorical_<date>.csv`: Tables 1 and 2, BLS (results/Table1_2_cont_normal.csv, Table1_2_cont_skew.csv, Table1_2_categorical.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/TableSX_CP_ROI_summary_NEW_<date>.csv`: Table S5 (results/descriptives_CP_BLS.csv)
  - `outputs/tables/TableSY_CD_ROI_summary_NEW_<date>.csv`: Table S7 (results/descriptives_CD_BLS.csv)
  - `outputs/figures/Outlier_counts_per_ROI_<date>.png`: Supplementary Figure S6
  - `checkpoints/eda_checkpoint.rds`: input for `Revision_2_1_3.qmd`

# Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(here)

fig_dir <- here::here("outputs", "figures")
tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

#### Helper Functions

```{r}
save_plot_png <- function(plot, filename, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300) {
  outfile <- file.path(
    fig_dir,
    paste0(filename, "_", format(Sys.Date()), ".png")
  )
  ggplot2::ggsave(outfile, plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  message("Plot saved to: ", outfile)
  return(outfile)
}
```

## Load data

```{r}
dat <- read_delim(
  here("data", "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),

    sex = factor(case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Male",
      sex == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

## Recode discrete variables

```{r}
find_discrete_candidates <- function(data, max_unique = 10) {
  data %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ list(unique(.)))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      everything(),
      names_to = "variable",
      values_to = "unique_values"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      n_unique = purrr::map_int(unique_values, length),
      sample_values = purrr::map_chr(unique_values, ~ paste(sort(.x), collapse = ", "))
    ) %>%
    filter(n_unique <= max_unique) %>%
    dplyr::select(variable, n_unique, sample_values) %>%
    arrange(n_unique)
}

cands <- find_discrete_candidates(dat, max_unique = 11) |>
  dplyr::pull(variable)

dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(cands) & where(~ !is.factor(.)),
      ~ factor(.x, levels = sort(unique(.x)))
    )
  )
```

# Sample characteristics (Tables 1 and 2)

```{r}
cont_normal <- c(
  "age_at_scan", "tz", "gew", "optn", "optg", "optws",
  "sif8", "stsed8", "stsgd8", "wie_gesiq",
  "colword", "colline", "interference",
  "ant_alerting", "ant_orienting", "ant_congruency"
)

cont_skewed <- c("b3z3", "betreu", "psi1", "inti")
cat_vars    <- c("sex", "ses0y2")

.pretty_name <- function(v) {
  if (exists("var_labels")) dplyr::coalesce(unname(var_labels[v]), v) else v
}

.split_ft_pt <- function(df, v) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(group, !!sym(v)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[v]]), !is.na(group)) %>%
    mutate(group = droplevels(group))
}

# normally distributed: t-test (Welch if variances differ)
summ_cont_normal <- purrr::map_dfr(cont_normal, function(v) {
  d <- .split_ft_pt(dat, v)
  if (nrow(d) == 0 || length(unique(d$group)) < 2) return(NULL)

  x <- d %>% filter(group == "FT") %>% pull(!!sym(v))
  y <- d %>% filter(group == "PT") %>% pull(!!sym(v))

  var_p <- tryCatch(var.test(x, y)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  use_welch <- is.finite(var_p) && !is.na(var_p) && var_p < 0.05

  tt <- t.test(x, y, var.equal = !use_welch)
  tt_t  <- unname(tt$statistic)
  tt_df <- unname(tt$parameter)
  tt_p  <- unname(tt$p.value)

  ft_n   <- length(x); pt_n <- length(y)
  ft_m   <- mean(x); ft_sd <- sd(x)
  pt_m   <- mean(y); pt_sd <- sd(y)
  ft_min <- min(x);  ft_max <- max(x)
  pt_min <- min(y);  pt_max <- max(y)

  tibble(
    Variable         = .pretty_name(v),
    n_FT             = ft_n,
    mean_sd_FT       = sprintf("%.2f±%.2f", ft_m, ft_sd),
    min_FT           = round(ft_min, 2),
    max_FT           = round(ft_max, 2),
    range_FT         = round(ft_max - ft_min, 2),
    n_PT             = pt_n,
    mean_sd_PT       = sprintf("%.2f±%.2f", pt_m, pt_sd),
    min_PT           = round(pt_min, 2),
    max_PT           = round(pt_max, 2),
    range_PT         = round(pt_max - pt_min, 2),
    t_df             = sprintf("%.2f(%s)%s",
                               tt_t,
                               ifelse(use_welch, sprintf("%.1f", tt_df), as.integer(round(tt_df))),
                               ifelse(use_welch, "*", "")),
    p                 = ifelse(tt_p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", tt_p))
  )
})

# skewed: Mann-Whitney U
summ_cont_skew <- purrr::map_dfr(cont_skewed, function(v) {
  d <- .split_ft_pt(dat, v)
  if (nrow(d) == 0 || length(unique(d$group)) < 2) return(NULL)

  x <- d %>% filter(group == "FT") %>% pull(!!sym(v))
  y <- d %>% filter(group == "PT") %>% pull(!!sym(v))

  wt <- wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE)
  U  <- unname(wt$statistic)
  p  <- unname(wt$p.value)

  fmt_med_iqr <- function(z) {
    med <- median(z); q1 <- quantile(z, .25); q3 <- quantile(z, .75)
    sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", med, q3 - q1)
  }

  ft_min <- min(x); ft_max <- max(x)
  pt_min <- min(y); pt_max <- max(y)

  tibble(
    Variable       = .pretty_name(v),
    n_FT           = length(x),
    med_iqr_FT     = fmt_med_iqr(x),
    min_FT         = round(ft_min, 2),
    max_FT         = round(ft_max, 2),
    range_FT       = round(ft_max - ft_min, 2),
    n_PT           = length(y),
    med_iqr_PT     = fmt_med_iqr(y),
    min_PT         = round(pt_min, 2),
    max_PT         = round(pt_max, 2),
    range_PT       = round(pt_max - pt_min, 2),
    U              = round(U, 1),
    p              = ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
  )
})

# categorical: Fisher's exact test
summ_cats <- purrr::map_dfr(cat_vars, function(v) {
  d <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(group, !!sym(v)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(.data[[v]])) %>%
    mutate(group = droplevels(group))

  if (nrow(d) == 0 || length(unique(d$group)) < 2) return(NULL)

  tab <- table(d$group, d[[v]])
  pval <- tryCatch(fisher.test(tab)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)

  lvls <- colnames(tab)
  pct_str <- function(row_vec) {
    total <- sum(row_vec)
    if (total == 0) return(paste(rep("0%", length(row_vec)), collapse = " / "))
    paste(sprintf("%d%%", round(100 * row_vec / total)), collapse = " / ")
  }

  ft_pct <- pct_str(tab["FT", , drop = FALSE])
  pt_pct <- pct_str(tab["PT", , drop = FALSE])

  tibble(
    Variable    = .pretty_name(v),
    n_FT        = sum(tab["FT", ]),
    pct_levels_FT = ft_pct,
    n_PT        = sum(tab["PT", ]),
    pct_levels_PT = pt_pct,
    levels_display = paste(lvls, collapse = " / "),
    p           = ifelse(!is.na(pval) && pval < .001, "<.001",
                         ifelse(is.na(pval), "—", sprintf("%.3f", pval)))
  )
})
readr::write_csv(summ_cont_normal, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Table1A_cont_normal_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
readr::write_csv(summ_cont_skew,   file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Table1B_cont_skew_",   Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
readr::write_csv(summ_cats,        file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Table1C_categorical_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

# CP and CD descriptives (Tables S5, S7)

```{r}
long_cp <- final_dat_CP %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, group, sex, age_at_scan, scanner_id, dplyr::starts_with("cp_")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::starts_with("cp_"),
                      names_to = "roi_code", values_to = "connectivity") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(roi = factor(roi_code, levels = names(roi_labels), labels = roi_labels))

long_cd <- final_dat_CD %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, group, sex, age_at_scan, scanner_id, dplyr::starts_with("cd_")) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::starts_with("cd_"),
                      names_to = "roi_code", values_to = "connectivity") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(roi = factor(roi_code, levels = names(roi_labels_CD), labels = roi_labels_CD))

classify_type <- function(roi_code) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("^c[pd]_c_|^c[pd]_sc_|^c[pd]_ac_hip|^c[pd]_sc_hip", roi_code) ~ "Limbic",
    grepl("^c[pd]_ac_", roi_code) ~ "Associative",
    grepl("^c[pd]_pc_", roi_code) ~ "Primary",
    TRUE ~ "Associative"
  )
}

summarize_roi_t <- function(long_df) {
  rois <- long_df %>%
    dplyr::select(group, roi_code, roi, connectivity) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(connectivity)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Type = classify_type(roi_code)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi, Type) %>%
    tidyr::nest() %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(rois)), function(i) {
    df  <- rois$data[[i]]
    rc  <- rois$roi_code[i]
    rnm <- as.character(rois$roi[i])
    typ <- rois$Type[i]

    x <- df %>% dplyr::filter(group == "FT") %>% dplyr::pull(connectivity)
    y <- df %>% dplyr::filter(group == "PT") %>% dplyr::pull(connectivity)
    if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) return(NULL)

    var_p <- tryCatch(var.test(x, y)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    use_welch <- is.finite(var_p) && !is.na(var_p) && var_p < 0.05

    tt <- t.test(x, y, var.equal = !use_welch)
    tt_t  <- unname(tt$statistic)
    tt_df <- unname(tt$parameter)
    tt_p  <- unname(tt$p.value)

    tibble(
      Type        = typ,
      ROI         = rnm,
      roi_code    = rc,
      n_FT        = length(x),
      mean_sd_FT  = sprintf("%.3f±%.3f", mean(x), sd(x)),
      min_FT      = sprintf("%.3f", min(x)),
      max_FT      = sprintf("%.3f", max(x)),
      range_FT    = sprintf("%.3f", max(x) - min(x)),
      n_PT        = length(y),
      mean_sd_PT  = sprintf("%.3f±%.3f", mean(y), sd(y)),
      min_PT      = sprintf("%.3f", min(y)),
      max_PT      = sprintf("%.3f", max(y)),
      range_PT    = sprintf("%.3f", max(y) - min(y)),
      `t(df)`     = sprintf("%.3f(%s)%s",
                            tt_t,
                            ifelse(use_welch, sprintf("%.2f", tt_df), as.integer(round(tt_df))),
                            ifelse(use_welch, "*", "")),
      p           = ifelse(tt_p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", tt_p))
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(factor(Type, levels = c("Associative","Primary","Limbic")),
                   ROI)
}

cp_table <- summarize_roi_t(long_cp)
cd_table <- summarize_roi_t(long_cd)
readr::write_csv2(cp_table, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("TableSX_CP_ROI_summary_NEW_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
readr::write_csv2(cd_table, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("TableSY_CD_ROI_summary_NEW_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```

# Outliers

Outliers per ROI: observations below Q1 - 1.5 IQR or above Q3 + 1.5 IQR.

### CP

```{r}
stopifnot(all(c("subject","roi_code","roi","connectivity") %in% names(long_cp)))

long_cp_outliers <- long_cp %>%
  dplyr::select(subject, roi_code, roi, value = connectivity)

cp_stats <- long_cp_outliers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    q1     = stats::quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3     = stats::quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr    = q3 - q1,
    lower  = q1 - 1.5 * iqr,
    upper  = q3 + 1.5 * iqr,
    mean   = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n      = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

outlier_table <- long_cp_outliers %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cp_stats, by = c("roi_code", "roi")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value) & ((value < lower) | (value > upper))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_outliers = dplyr::n()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(roi, subject) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(c(value, mean, median, lower, upper), ~ round(.x, 4)))

roi_totals <- long_cp %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  summarise(total_n = sum(!is.na(connectivity)), .groups = "drop")

outlier_summary <- outlier_table %>%
  dplyr::group_by(roi_code, roi) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_outliers = dplyr::n(),
    subjects   = paste(subject, collapse = ", "),
    values     = paste(value, collapse = ", "),
    lower      = dplyr::first(lower),
    upper      = dplyr::first(upper),
    mean       = dplyr::first(mean),
    median     = dplyr::first(median),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_outliers))

outlier_summary <- outlier_summary %>%
  left_join(roi_totals, by = "roi") %>%
  mutate(
    perc_out = 100 * n_outliers / total_n,
    label_text = paste0(n_outliers, " (", round(perc_out, 1), "%)")
  )
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    perc_out = 100 * n_outliers / total_n,
    label_text = paste0(n_outliers, " (", round(perc_out, 1), "%)")
  )
```

### Figure S6: number of outliers per ROI (CP)

```{r}
p_cp_outlier_counts <- ggplot(outlier_summary, aes(x = reorder(roi, n_outliers), y = n_outliers, fill = n_outliers)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_text),

save_plot_png(p_cp_outlier_counts, "Outlier_counts_per_ROI")
```

### Datasets with outliers excluded

```{r}
final_dat_CP_excl <- final_dat_CP

for (i in seq_len(nrow(cp_stats))) {
  roi_var <- cp_stats$roi_code[i]
  lower   <- cp_stats$lower[i]
  upper   <- cp_stats$upper[i]
  
  final_dat_CP_excl[[roi_var]] <- ifelse(
    final_dat_CP_excl[[roi_var]] < lower | final_dat_CP_excl[[roi_var]] > upper,
    NA,
    final_dat_CP_excl[[roi_var]]
  )
}
```

# Intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH)

```{r}
dat_icb <- final_dat_CP %>%
  mutate(
    icb_raw = as.numeric(as.character(hemo)),
    icb_fac = factor(icb_raw, levels = 0:4,
                     labels = c("0","Stage 1","Stage 2","Stage 3", "Stage 4"))
  )

table(dat_icb$icb_fac, dat_icb$group, useNA="ifany")
```

### Association between IVH grade and CP (per ROI)

```{r}
cp_vars <- names(final_dat_CP) %>% grep("^cp_", ., value = TRUE)

fit_one <- function(var, data = dat_icb) {
  f <- as.formula(paste(var, "~ icb_raw + group + sex + age_at_scan"))
  m <- lm(f, data = data)
  broom::tidy(m) %>% mutate(roi_code = var)
}

cp_results <- map_dfr(cp_vars, fit_one) %>%
  filter(term == "icb_raw") %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

cp_results %>% dplyr::select(roi_code, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, p_adj) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

### Overlap of IVH and outliers

```{r}
outlier_CP <- outlier_table    %>% distinct(subject) %>% mutate(metric = "CP")
outlier_CD <- outlier_table_CD %>% distinct(subject) %>% mutate(metric = "CD")

outlier_subjects_split <- full_join(outlier_CP, outlier_CD, by = "subject", suffix = c("_cp","_cd")) %>%
  mutate(
    outlier_group = case_when(
      !is.na(metric_cp) & is.na(metric_cd) ~ "CP only",
      is.na(metric_cp) & !is.na(metric_cd) ~ "CD only",
      !is.na(metric_cp) & !is.na(metric_cd) ~ "Both",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

icb_subjects <- dat_icb %>%
  filter(!is.na(icb_raw) & icb_raw > 0) %>%
  distinct(subject)

outlier_subjects_split <- outlier_subjects_split %>%
  mutate(
    ICB = if_else(subject %in% icb_subjects$subject, "Yes", "No")
  )

summary_table <- outlier_subjects_split %>%
  count(outlier_group, ICB) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ICB, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = Yes + No)

summary_table
```
